bibliographic.title: Only What You Admit
bibliographic.author: Danielle Brathwaite-Shirley
bibliographic.description:
YOU HAVE BEEN HIDING

YOUR EMOTIONS

YOUR OPINIONS

YOUR DESIRES

YOUR DISGUSTS

YOUR SECRETS

YOUR FEARS

YOU WILL BE ASKED TO CONFRONT THEM HERE

YOU MAY FIND IT DIFFICULT

THE ANSWERS YOU GIVE WILL REMAIN ON THIS MACHINE

DO NOT GO THROUGH THIS IF YOU ARE NOT READY

TO BE UNCOMFORTABLE

TO BE HONEST

TO TAKE RISK

AND BE HELD TO YOUR ANSWERS
